info.name: BookBuddy Agent API
info.description:
HTTP API for the sample FastAPI + LangChain book-discovery agent.

Start the backend first:

```
uvicorn backend.main:app --reload --port 8000
```

Then set the collection variable `baseUrl` if you are not on `http://localhost:8000`.

## How a conversation works

Every conversation is one `session_id`. Send the **same** id on `/chat`, `/chat/stream`, `/approve`, and `/reject`. The Tests script on **Send a message** saves `session_id` and, when the agent pauses, `action_id`, into collection variables. Later requests use `{{session_id}}` and `{{action_id}}`.

Suggested order:

1. **Health** — confirm the server is up and which checkpoint backend is active.
2. **Send a message** — `Find sci-fi classics`. Expect `status: completed`.
3. **Send a message** again — `Tell me more about number 2`. Same `session_id`, so the agent still has the list.
4. **Send a message** again — `I want to read number 1`. Expect `status: awaiting_approval`. The URL is not included yet. `action_id` is saved automatically.
5. **Approve** — the agent resumes and `handoff_url` is the Open Library link. Or **Reject** — no URL.
6. **Get session** — the transcript. **Delete session** — wipe it (next call is 404).

`GET /books/{work_key}` does not use the agent or a session. It calls Open Library directly.

## Response shape for /chat, /approve, /reject

```json
{
  "session_id": "postman-demo",
  "status": "completed",
  "response": "I found these books...",
  "pending_action": null,
  "handoff_url": null
}
```

`status` is `completed` or `awaiting_approval`.

When `awaiting_approval`, `pending_action` looks like:

```json
{
  "action_id": "copy-this-into-approve",
  "tool_name": "proceed_to_borrow",
  "arguments": {"work_key": "OL893414W", "title": "Dune", "author": "Frank Herbert"},
  "description": "You selected:\n  Title:  Dune\n..."
}
```

`handoff_url` is set only after a successful **Approve**. It stays null on Reject and while approval is pending.

## Errors

Failures are JSON `{"detail": "one friendly sentence"}`. You should never see a Python traceback.

| Code | When |
|------|------|
| 400 | `GET /books/{work_key}` with a key that is not an Open Library work id |
| 404 | Unknown session, or unknown book id |
| 409 | Approve/Reject when nothing is pending, or the `action_id` is stale |
| 422 | Body failed validation (empty `message`, missing `action_id`, …) |
| 502 | Open Library returned an unexpected error on `GET /books/{work_key}` |
| 503 | LLM is down (`/chat`, `/approve`, `/reject`) or the catalogue is down (`GET /books`) |

Full write-up: `docs/02_fastapi_layer.md`, `docs/07_human_in_the_loop.md`, `docs/15_sessions.md`.

variable.description: Conversation id. Reuse it for every message in one chat. The Send a message test script overwrites this with the id the server echoes back.
Set automatically when Send a message returns status awaiting_approval. Required by Approve and Reject.
Open Library work id. OL893414W is Dune. Comes back as work_key on search results.

item.name: Health

request.description:
Confirms the process is serving and shows which model and memory backend it started with.

No body. No session.

### 200

```json
{
  "status": "ok",
  "llm_model": "openai:gpt-4o-mini",
  "checkpoint_backend": "memory"
}
```

`checkpoint_backend` is `memory` (lost on restart) or `sqlite` (Bonus 5, `CHECKPOINT_BACKEND=sqlite`).

Call this first. If it fails, uvicorn is not running or `baseUrl` is wrong.

item.description: Liveness. Does not touch the agent or Open Library.

item.name: Conversation

request.description:
One user turn. The agent may call tools (search, details, authors) and then answer. This call waits until the turn finishes, which can take 10–20 seconds when tools run.

### Body

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `message` | yes | 1–2000 characters. Empty string → **422**. |
| `session_id` | no | If you omit it, the server mints one and returns it. **You must reuse that id** or the next message is a new empty conversation. This request sends `{{session_id}}`. |

### What to send, in order

Edit `message` and send again with the same session:

1. `Find sci-fi classics` → `status: completed`, a numbered list.
2. `Tell me more about number 2` → the agent resolves "number 2" from this session's history.
3. `I want to read number 1` → `status: awaiting_approval`. Copy is unnecessary: the Tests script stores `pending_action.action_id` in `{{action_id}}`. Then run **Approve** or **Reject**.

### 200 completed

`pending_action` and `handoff_url` are null. Show `response`.

### 200 awaiting_approval

The `proceed_to_borrow` tool has **not** run. `handoff_url` is null on purpose. Show `pending_action.description` and call `/approve` or `/reject` with `pending_action.action_id`.

### Errors

- **422** `Invalid message: ...` — empty or oversized `message`.
- **503** `The AI service is temporarily unavailable.` — model key, quota, or network. The real reason is in the uvicorn log, not this body.

If you send a new message while an approval card is still pending, the server treats that as a reject and then answers the new message.

response.name: 200 completed
response.body:
{
  "session_id": "postman-demo",
  "status": "completed",
  "response": "1. **Dune** by Frank Herbert (1965)\n2. **Foundation** by Isaac Asimov (1951)",
  "pending_action": null,
  "handoff_url": null
}

response.name: 200 awaiting approval
422 empty message

request.description:
Same body and same session rules as **Send a message**. The answer is a Server-Sent Events stream instead of one JSON document. The turn is still saved on `{{session_id}}`, so a later `/chat` or `GET /sessions/{{session_id}}` sees it.

Postman buffers the body and shows it when the stream ends. For live frames use:

```
curl -N -X POST {{baseUrl}}/chat/stream \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"message":"Find sci-fi classics","session_id":"{{session_id}}"}'
```

### Frames, in order

```
event: status
data: {"type":"status","message":"Searching the catalogue…"}

event: token
data: {"type":"token","content":"I found"}

event: done
data: {"type":"done","session_id":"postman-demo","status":"completed","response":"I found these books...","pending_action":null,"handoff_url":null}
```

1. Zero or more `status` frames while a tool runs.
2. Zero or more `token` frames (pieces of the answer).
3. Exactly one `done` frame. This is the same object `/chat` would have returned. Trust `done`, not the concatenated tokens, for `pending_action` and `handoff_url`.

On failure after the stream has started you get `event: error` with `{"type":"error","detail":"The AI service is temporarily unavailable."}` and HTTP 200, because the status code was already sent.

Headers `Cache-Control: no-cache` and `X-Accel-Buffering: no` tell proxies not to hold the stream.

If `done.status` is `awaiting_approval`, run **Approve** or **Reject** with `done.pending_action.action_id`. This request does not auto-save `action_id` (the body is not a single JSON object).

response.name: 200 event stream

item.description: Talk to the agent. Both routes take the same JSON body. `/chat` returns one object. `/chat/stream` returns Server-Sent Events.

item.name: Human in the loop

request.description:
Run the paused `proceed_to_borrow` tool and let the agent finish its reply.

Only call this after **Send a message** returned `status: awaiting_approval`. `{{action_id}}` is filled by that request's Tests script. If you skipped it, paste `pending_action.action_id` into the collection variable `action_id` (or into this body).

### Body

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `session_id` | yes | The conversation that is paused. |
| `action_id` | yes | Must match the live interrupt. A wrong or old id → **409**. |

### 200

`status` is `completed`. `handoff_url` is the Open Library page, for example `https://openlibrary.org/works/OL893414W`. `response` tells the user to continue there. The app does not borrow the book.

### Errors

- **409** `There is no action awaiting approval in this session.` — nothing is paused (already approved, rejected, or never asked).
- **409** `That action is no longer pending...` — `action_id` does not match the current pause.
- **422** — `session_id` or `action_id` missing.
- **503** — the model failed while resuming. The tool may already have run; check the uvicorn log before retrying.

response.name: 200 approved
response.body:
{
  "session_id": "postman-demo",
  "status": "completed",
  "response": "You approved this book. Continue on Open Library to read or borrow it: https://openlibrary.org/works/OL893414W",
  "pending_action": null,
  "handoff_url": "https://openlibrary.org/works/OL893414W"
}

response.name: 409 nothing pending

request.description:
Cancel the paused hand-off. The tool does **not** run, so there is no Open Library URL.

Same body as **Approve**: `session_id` plus the `action_id` from `pending_action`. Use one or the other, not both, for a given pause.

### 200

`status` is `completed`. `handoff_url` is null. `response` is the agent acknowledging the cancellation and offering to keep browsing.

### Errors

Same as Approve: **409** if nothing is pending or `action_id` is stale, **422** if a field is missing, **503** if the model fails while writing the acknowledgement.

response.name: 200 rejected
response.body:
{
  "session_id": "postman-demo",
  "status": "completed",
  "response": "No problem — I won't continue to Open Library. Want to keep browsing?",
  "pending_action": null,
  "handoff_url": null
}

response.name: 409 stale action id

item.description: Run these only while a session is paused (`status: awaiting_approval`). Approve reveals `handoff_url`. Reject does not.

item.name: Sessions

request.description:
Read the transcript stored for this conversation. Does not call the model.

Path parameter `session_id` is the collection variable, so it matches whatever **Send a message** last saved.

### 200

```json
{
  "session_id": "postman-demo",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "user", "content": "Find sci-fi classics"},
    {"role": "assistant", "content": "1. **Dune** by Frank Herbert (1965)"}
  ],
  "has_pending_action": false
}
```

`messages` is only user and assistant text. Tool calls and raw JSON stay inside the checkpoint; they are not in this payload. `has_pending_action` is true while Approve/Reject is still outstanding.

### 404

`Unknown session '...'` — this id was never used, or it was deleted. With `CHECKPOINT_BACKEND=memory`, restarting uvicorn also drops every session.

response.name: 200 history

request.description:
Delete this conversation from the checkpointer (memory or sqlite). The next `GET /sessions/{{session_id}}` is **404**, and a new `/chat` with the same id starts from an empty history.

No body. **204** has an empty body on success.

**404** if the id was never used or was already deleted.

The Streamlit **New conversation** button calls this, then generates a fresh id.

item.description: Inspect or wipe one conversation. The id in the path is the same `session_id` you send to `/chat`.

item.name: Books

request.description:
Fetch one book from Open Library **without** the agent. Useful for a details card in a UI, and for checking that the service layer works when you do not want to spend an LLM call.

Path parameter `work_key` defaults to `OL893414W` (Dune). A search tool result's `work_key` is the value to put here. A leading `/works/` is stripped server-side; `OL893414W` is enough.

No session. Needs network access to `openlibrary.org`. Behind a corporate proxy, set `USE_SYSTEM_CERTS=true` or this returns **503**.

### 200

```json
{
  "work_key": "OL893414W",
  "title": "Dune",
  "authors": ["Frank Herbert"],
  "description": "Set on the desert planet Arrakis...",
  "subjects": ["Science fiction"],
  "first_publish_date": "1965",
  "cover_url": "https://covers.openlibrary.org/b/id/...-L.jpg",
  "url": "https://openlibrary.org/works/OL893414W"
}
```

### Errors

- **400** — the id is not shaped like an Open Library work id (`OL`…`W`).
- **404** — well-formed id, but Open Library has no such work (`I couldn't find anything matching that id.`).
- **503** — catalogue timeout or connection failure (`The book catalogue service is temporarily unavailable...`).

response.name: 200 Dune
response.body:
{
  "work_key": "OL893414W",
  "title": "Dune",
  "authors": ["Frank Herbert"],
  "description": "Set on the desert planet Arrakis, Dune is the story of the boy Paul Atreides...",
  "subjects": ["Science fiction", "Fiction"],
  "first_publish_date": "1965",
  "cover_url": "https://covers.openlibrary.org/b/id/11481354-L.jpg",
  "url": "https://openlibrary.org/works/OL893414W"
}

response.name: 400 bad work key
404 unknown work
